'''Serenity''' was a brief meditative state that a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] could enter into to regain focus and power. Because it required patience, inner strength, and a deep connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], this ability was almost only attainable by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]].

==Users==
===Qui-Gon Jinn===
During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] encountered [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. After they had engaged in a heated battle, there was brief pause in the fight when security shields separated Maul from Qui-Gon. Jinn took advantage of the break in the duel to crouch down and enter a Serenity trance. When the shields deactivated, Jinn emerged from his trance and immediately attacked Maul. However, the Jedi Master eventually lost the battle and his life to the Sith Lord.<ref name="The Phantom Menace" />

===Yoda===
{{Quote|Supreme Leader, we found the Jedi.''"<br />"''Excellent. Where is he?''"<br />"''He's just sitting here in front of our tanks.''"<br />"''Shoot him! Shoot him now!|[[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] [[224/Legends|224]] and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]|<ref name="Ambush">{{TCW|Ambush}}</ref>}}
[[File:Yoda-Serenity.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in a Serenity trance]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] was on a [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|mission to Rugosa]] where he encountered [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and a battalion of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]]. Yoda only had three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], and they were already low on ammunition. Ordering his [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to temporarily hold position, Yoda jumped down into canyon into the midst of the army and entered into a Serenity trance. After thinking he had cut off the Jedi Master's escape, [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] [[224/Legends|224]] contacted Ventress to tell her he located the Jedi. When 224 described Master Yoda's pose, Ventress became very alarmed and ordered the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to open fire immediately. However, Yoda emerged from his Serenity trance and destroyed the three tanks and a large number of droids. With the help of his three clones, Master Yoda was able to destroy the entire battalion of droid forces.<ref name="Ambush" />
